# Draw the Ball ⚾

#### Course: Brick Breaker with JavaScript

## Draw the Ball ⚾

The ball is a circle centered at (x, y) with a given radius. On canvas, arc(x, y, radius, startAngle, endAngle) traces a circular path. Using 0 to Math.PI * 2 traces the full circle.

The ball's starting position sits just above the paddle. The constants define where that is:

```javascriptDOM
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 360;
const PADDLE_Y = CANVAS_HEIGHT - 40;  // 320px from top
const BALL_RADIUS = 9;

// Ball starts at y = 320 - 9 = 311
```

That way "reset ball to paddle" and "initial position" are the same operation — reset() sets both x and y to the starting coordinates.
